# Real MIDI files

Standard MIDI Files made outside head_music, copied unchanged for MIDI import's real-file specs.

## Mutopia

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `mutopia/BWV-117a.mid` | <https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BachJS/BWV117a/BWV-117a/BWV-117a.mid> |

- **Piece:** Polonaise in F major, BWV Anh. 117a, by J. S. Bach, for piano, from the Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach.
- **Source:** the [Mutopia Project](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1013), Mutopia-2007/07/26-1013, typeset by Steven McDougall from the Bach-Gesellschaft Ausgabe, Band 43 (1894), and written as MIDI by GNU LilyPond 2.10.25. Downloaded 2026-10-16.
- **License:** Public Domain. The piece's page gives its copyright as "Public Domain", and the LilyPond source says "This sheet music has been placed in the public domain by the typesetter".
